get.description: Returns the custom duplicate rules defined for an account. Each rule specifies the properties used to detect matching records. Use objectType to filter by record type, or ruleId to retrieve a specific rule.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of records to filter rules by, such as contacts or companies. If omitted, rules for all supported record types are returned.

parameters.name: ruleId
parameters.description: The ID of a specific rule to retrieve.

get.description: Returns groups of records that match a custom duplicate rule. Records are grouped when they share identical values for the properties defined in the rule. Supports three lookup modes: list all groups for a rule (ruleId), retrieve a specific group (ruleId + groupId), or find all groups containing a specific record (objectId).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A pagination cursor returned in a previous response. Pass this value to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: The ID of a specific group to retrieve. Requires ruleId.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of groups to return per page. Defaults to 10, maximum 100. Only applies when listing groups by ruleId.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: Returns all groups that contain this record.

parameters.name: objectsPerGroup
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return per group. Defaults to 10, maximum 100.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of records to retrieve groups for, such as contacts or companies. Required.

parameters.name: ruleId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom duplicate rule to retrieve groups for. Required when using groupId.

get.description:
Returns pairs of records identified as potential duplicates by HubSpot's default detection method. Records are scored by similarity across a standard set of properties. Use objectId to narrow results to pairs containing a specific record. To detect duplicates using custom matching criteria, see the custom duplicate rules endpoints.

By default, HubSpot identifies potential duplicates by comparing record property values for the following properties:

Contacts: First name, Last name, Email address, IP country, Phone number, Zip code, and Company name.
Companies: Company domain name, Company name, Country/Region, Phone number, and Industry.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A pagination cursor returned in a previous response. Pass this value to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of pairs to return per page. Defaults to 25, maximum 200.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record to check for duplicates. Returns only pairs that contain this record.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of records to check for duplicates, such as contacts or companies. Required.

results.description: An array of PublicDuplicateGroup objects, each representing a group of duplicates identified by a custom rule.
An array of PublicDuplicatePair objects, each representing a pair of records identified as potential duplicates.

total.description: The total number of duplicate pairs matching the request.

results.description: The list of custom duplicate rules on this page.

total.description: The total number of custom duplicate rules matching the request.

ruleId.description: The ID of the custom duplicate rule that produced this group.
